_comment: Where the icing nodes stand and whom to warn. The ETSI MEC Sandbox V2X scenario is an emulated network over Monaco (not a real deployment). The vehicle 10.100.0.1 drives a long deterministic loop; a single mec_probe.py --track 120 window only shows one segment of it (two windows sampled 2026-11-14 covered lat 43.744->43.733 and lat 43.737->43.728). The three nodes are spread across both observed segments so the vehicle approaches at least one during a ~2-min replay, with radius_m widened to 700 m for margin. If your demo window shows a different segment, re-run mec_probe.py --track and move a node onto it.
